source.feed_evidence: feed=iex is sent explicitly by src/historical_download.py and by the live src/broker_alpaca.py.
source.adjustment_evidence: Sent explicitly as adjustment=raw. Verified 2026-09-24: NVDA 2024-06-07 bars are ~1190 USD raw vs ~118.6 with adjustment=split, so stored prices and volumes are NOT split-adjusted (NVDA 10:1 split on 2024-06-10 is a raw discontinuity).
source.sessions: All bars returned by the API are stored, including pre-market and after-hours. The strategy only decides when the decision instant is inside 09:30-16:00 America/New_York.
source.timestamps: UTC, ISO-8601 with Z; each timestamp is the bar START (a 1Min bar at 13:35Z covers [13:35, 13:36)).
source.missing_minutes: IEX bars are trade-based: a minute with no IEX trade has no bar. Missing minutes are expected and are never filled or invented.
source.plan_notes: Rate limit header reports 200 requests/min. A probe on 2026-09-24 also returned SIP bars for 2023-12-01, but SIP is not used because the live bot trades on IEX data.
